## Description

Produce docs/03-architecture/data-classification.md listing every planned field for P0–P2 entities with its class (public, internal, personal, sensitive health, national ID) and control (RLS, masking, Always Encrypted, audit-on-read). Finalise the ERD → Azure SQL mapping (uuid → uniqueidentifier, jsonb → json/nvarchar(max)+ISJSON, exclusion constraint → unique slot index + app lock, RLS policies → security predicates, money → bigint minor units). Add a [Classification] attribute in code used by the PHI redaction processor and EF configuration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every column in the P0 schema has a classification attribute; a unit test fails if a new entity property lacks one.
- [ ] **AC2.** The register lists the Always Encrypted column set and the masking set used by MDV-P0-009.
- [ ] **AC3.** The mapping table closes the PRD completeness item "ERD mapped to Azure SQL types" (status Covered).
- [ ] **AC4.** The data map (what data, where stored, which country, which processors) is published as part of the P0 delivery package.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
